caution.para: This feature is in progress.separate transports are not yet negotiated or used.

listitem.para: Whether to negotiate the use of separate transports for IKE and ESP. IKE is carried over TCP, which is reliable and so copes with the large key exchange payloads used by post-quantum algorithms, while ESP continues to use UDP (or is sent directly over IP), avoiding the head-of-line blocking that TCP would impose on the data. IKEv2 only.
This differs from enable-tcp=, which selects the transport used for both IKE and ESP.
